_doc: Arena 7 (retail world 38: a graveyard) kit for the map editor (S36), same schema as art/arena6/kit.json. The stone surfaces reuse the arena 6 loom textures. Pieces the arena also uses from the other kits are listed in shared.  kind cap = lies over another block's top: y = 0 is that top, the lip hangs over its sides; top = the walk surface above that top (m). on: block = stacked on top of another block (y = 0 is where it rests on it).

pieces.name: wall_top
pieces.label: Remate del muro (a dos aguas)
pieces.note: the ridge runs along x; turn it to follow the wall

pieces.name: iron_railing
pieces.label: Reja de hierro
pieces.note: three spikes in a row along x, centred in the cell; on the wall tops or round the graves

pieces.label: Losa de tierra (sobre otro bloque)
pieces.note: the floor of the graveyard; the eight retail drawings only move the cracks
